mapper.select: SELECT qna_no, user_no, qna_title, qna_file, is_answered, created_date FROM qna_board ORDER BY qna_no DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO qna_board ( qna_no, user_no, user_name, qna_title, qna_content, qna_file, is_answered, created_date ) VALUES ( SEQ_QNA_NO.NEXTVAL, #{user_no}, (SELECT user_name FROM user_info WHERE user_no = #{user_no}), #{qna_title}, #{qna_content}, #{qna_file}, 'N', SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT qna_no, user_no, qna_title, qna_content, qna_file, is_answered, created_date FROM qna_board WHERE qna_no = #{qna_no}
